topics.label: Course Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecturer, the cancer lecture series, and the specific learning objectives for the session.

topics.label: Cancer Etiology: Intrinsic Mechanisms and Extrinsic Risks
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the conceptual framework of cancer causation by evaluating the interplay between intrinsic genetic mutations, endogenous biological errors, and extrinsic environmental risk factors.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Carcinogenesis and Tumor Promotion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular and cellular mechanisms through which specific chemical, physical, and infectious agents act as initiators or promoters in malignant transformation.

topics.label: Methodologies for Detecting and Proving Carcinogenicity
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the genomic, epidemiological, in vivo, and in vitro methods used to identify mutational signatures and test the carcinogenicity of substances.

topics.label: Lecture Summary and Risk-Benefit Assessment
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with a summary of environmental cancer risks and reflections on real-world risk-benefit decision-making.
